title: Output capture with isolation (foundational)
description: Signature original: The program under test runs in a controlled harness that captures stdout, stderr, return code, and runtime. Capture is isolated so a crashing program cannot take the validator down with it. The captured bundle is the evidence the validator judges. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'print(40 + 2)'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
print('returncode:', r.returncode, '| stdout:', r.stdout.strip())
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Execution Result Validator, 2026-10-21.

title: Tolerance checking for numeric outputs (foundational)
description: Signature original: Numeric outputs are compared with an explicit tolerance, absolute or relative, declared per requirement. Tolerance checking avoids false failures from floating-point representation, where 0.1 + 0.2 is not exactly 0.3. The tolerance used is recorded with the verdict. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
got, want, tol = 0.1 + 0.2, 0.3, 1e-9
print('within tolerance:', abs(got - want) <= tol, f'(tol={tol})')

title: Regression comparison against golden outputs (foundational)
description: Signature original: Current output is diffed against a golden output recorded from a known-good run. Diffs are reported line by line so the change is visible, not just 'different'. Golden outputs are versioned with the program so the comparison stays meaningful as the program evolves. Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
demo:
# Signature-authored original (JAH).
import difflib
golden = ['hits: 42\n', 'time: 0.4s\n']
current = ['hits: 42\n', 'time: 0.6s\n']
diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(golden, current, lineterm=''))
print('regression diff lines:', len(diff), '| sample:', diff[4].strip() if len(diff) > 4 else 'none')
provenance: Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH) for Execution Result Validator, 2026-10-21.

title: Validation verdict with evidence (foundational)

Foundational form: the core technique demonstrated on a minimal example. Signature-authored original by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH).
